sourceScope: Frozen candidate V4, after the durable activation index witness was introduced but before repeating its validation at the actual restore boundary. This probe does not claim a baseline reproduction of this specific witness gap.
setup: Owned isolated repository; Layer commit A, legitimate legacy-shelf staged B, and a real interruption after the exact B index publication. The pending protected journal contains the BEFORE/AFTER fingerprint and durable index identity witness.

interference.boundary: After the first backup read chunk during recovery copyRegular, before the private copy returns, timestamp restoration and final target check.
interference.operation: Create an independent equal-byte B index, set its mtime by FD to 60 seconds later, fsync it, and rename it over the live private index.

result: CONFIRMED_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: foreign staged B was replaced by A and the journal was completed. A successful preflight identity check was insufficient because the final restore target check compared only bytes/mode.
retention: Raw receipt and exact PROBE.mjs remain in the externally retained owned fixture. Host paths, fixture nonce and raw device/inode identifiers are omitted from this public projection.
correctiveDirection: Reuse a single identity-bracketed fingerprint/lock guard at recovery preflight, each restore-loop entry including early continue, and the final rename/unlink boundary after copying/restamping the private temporary. Repeated refusal must preserve the foreign index, native locks, backup and journal.
finalValidation: Directed regressions and subsequent full campaigns are separate from this failing V4 observation; see RESULTS.md. No power-loss or universal filesystem CAS guarantee is claimed.
